title: Stanley Druckenmiller on Economy, Stocks, Bonds, Trump, Fed: Full Interview
description: Billionaire investor Stanley Druckenmiller discusses the outlook for the U.S. economy, his investment strategy for stocks and bonds, President Donald Trump's attempts to sway Federal Reserve policy and the prospects for a solution to the U.S.-China trade dispute. He talks with Bloomberg's Erik Schatzker. (This interview was from December 17, 2018)
